Final for Publication

NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
167-71 North Morgan Street
From C1-2 to DX-5

The Property

The Property currently consists of a three-story industrial building located in the Fulton-Randolph Market District
of Chicago’s Downtown area. The surrounding area is comprised of varying zoning districts including DX-7, DX-
5, DX-3, Cl-3, and C1-2. The area is in the heart of the West Loop/Fulton Market with a variety of building
heights from three-stories to a 350 foot tower across the street of the property and comprised of predominantly
multi-family and commercial uses. The property is also a Transit Served Location per the Transit Oriented
Provisions of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, Section 17-10-0102-B(1), as it is within 140 feet of the CTA
Morgan/Lake station entrance.

The Project

The Applicant proposes to construct a new, five-story mixed-use, residential building containing 20 dwelling units
(including 4 affordable units on-site), with no automobile parking spaces, 20 bicycle parking spaces, and
approximately 3,300 square feet of ground floor commercial space. The proposed maximum height of the building
is 68 feet 3 inches. To allow the proposed development, the Applicant seeks a zoning change for the subject
property from C1-2 to DX-5. The Applicant is filing a Type 1 rezoning application and seeks all relief necessary
and as allowed by 17-13-0300-D of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance for the proposed project, including but not
limited to: 1) a variation under § 17-13-1101-B to reduce the required rear yard setback (East) to 0°; 2) a variation
under § 17-13-1003-W and § 17-13-1101-A to eliminate the on-site open space requirement set forth in § 17-4-
0410; and 3) a variation to reduce the required number of automobile parking spaces from 10 to 0 under § 17-13-
1003-EE and § 17-13-1101-A.

17-4-0301 Specific Criteria for Transit Served Locations Requirements:
1. The project complies with the applicable standards of Section 17-10-0102-B:

RESPONSE: The project complies with Section 17-10-0102-B as the property is a Transit Served
Location as it is within 140 feet of the CTA Morgan/Lake station entrance.

2. The project complies with the standards and regulations of Section 17-4-0504, except paragraph E if the
project is not located along a pedestrian street and except paragraph C if the land use is designated in a non-
commercial use group, pertaining to pedestrian streets and pedestrian retail streets, even if the project is not
located along a pedestrian street or a pedestrian retail street:

RESPONSE: The project is not located along a pedestrian street but does include a commercial uses
group, so paragraph E does not apply, and the project is compliant with Paragraph C. As described
below, the project will comply with Section 17-4-0504 standards because:

e Building Location (B)(1): The Morgan Street, front yard facade, is compliant as it abuts the sidewalk;
e Transparency: the attached plans demonstrate compliance with this section.

© Doors and Entrances (D): The building’s main entrances will be on North Morgan Street;

e Prohibited Uses (E ): None of the prohibited uses are proposed for the project.

e Parking Location (F):The project is proposed with zero parking spaces; and

e Driveways and Vehicle Access (G): The Applicant proposes no parking or curb cuts.

3. The project complies with the general goals set forth in the Transit Friendly Development Guide: Station Area
Typology, and any other station-specific plans, designs or guidelines adopted by the Chicago Plan
Commission:

RESPONSE: The property is identified under the Transit Friendly Guide station topography as Major
Activity Center. This typography calls for a mix of residential, commercial and employment-generating
uses, with residential typically provided in mid-to high-rise buildings.

4. Residential building projects shall not have a number of parking spaces in excess of 50% of the Minimum
Automobile Parking Ratio for the applicable district listed in Section 17-10-0208 with any fractional result
rounded up to the next higher whole number, unless additional parking spaces are approved as
an administrative adjustment under the provisions of Section 17-13-1003-EE; and

RESPONSE: The project complies as it will have zero parking on-site.

5. The project complies with the Travel Demand Study and Management Plan rules of the Chicago Department
of Transportation.
RESPONSE: As a development consisting of 20 residential units, the project is exempt from the TDM
provisions as a Tier 0 project, in accordance with CDOT regulations.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 6,314 sq. ft.

Floor Area: 27,707 sq. ft.

FAR: 4.39

Residential Dwelling Units: 20

MLA Density: 315.70 sq. ft.

Height: 68 feet 3 inches (to top of roof enclosure)

Automobile Parking: 0

Bicycle Parking: 20

Setbacks:
Front (West) 0’
Side (North) 0°
Side (South) 0’
Rear (East) 0’
